correctness.rationale: C PASS. Correctly identifies components of two independent involutions as odd alternating paths (weight 1), two colors of even paths (each 1/2), and doubled-edge/cyclic 2k-cycles (weight 1/(2k), including k=1). The exponential GF exp(z/(1−z))(1−z²)^(−1/2) equals I_n²/n!. Multivariate factorial moments are ∏w_t·a_(n−S)/a_n; elementary involution recurrence bounds imply ratio→1 and joint finite Poisson limits. Effective bounded-degree Hanf locality reduces each fixed FO sentence to finitely many bounded small-component counts; long paths force remaining local types to exceed any fixed threshold. Every finite Boolean event Z_t>=h is FO-definable by quantifying and closing entire components. Divergent, vanishing cycle weights 1/(2k) have dense finite subset sums, so attainable 1−exp(−∑1/(2k)) are dense in [0,1]. The rational e^(−1/D) finite-threshold law is effective with sentence-dependent D. Independent finite enumeration/ratio checks support component counts, but locality and density are analytic proofs, not extrapolated from n<=7.
